_about: Other names for issuing organisations, so a link or a search that uses one name finds the documents the Atlas records under another. alias is the other name; issuingOrg is the Issuing Organisation exactly as the Atlas documents record it (data/results); iso3 is the country of those documents. One alias may resolve to several organisations, one row each. Every alias comes from a name already in the Atlas data: a guide's issuer in data/lab/readiness/readiness.json, a Gov Actors line of a profile, a document summary or a quoted excerpt (see basis). scripts/lab/invariants/site.mjs checks that each row matches at least one included document.
